verdict.rationale: Missive ships its own official MCP server. The changelog says external AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor can connect through MCP and act on conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts with chosen permissions, and a probe confirms a dedicated MCP server docs page. Missive's separate custom-MCP client feature is not credited here. Missing for 10: setup, authentication and tool-list detail for the server in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: External AI apps like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor can now connect to Missive through the Model Context Protocol and act on your conversations, contacts, calendar, and drafts, with the permissions you choose.
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server
